item.title: Automated DevSecOps Pipeline for Android Applications
item.description: A fully automated Android security pipeline built on Jenkins across two AWS EC2 instances, integrating Semgrep, Gitleaks, SonarQube, Trivy, MobSF, and DefectDojo to cover every security layer from source to APK.
